verdict_scope: The frozen P1342 R1 checker is not sufficiently discriminatory for the focal real-binding fragment. This is not an implementation verdict, final certificate, lifecycle/profile conclusion, NT01-NT06 conclusion or terminal-policy conclusion.

harness.method: Import the exact frozen checker, deep-copy the frozen selected-r1 DTO and manifest, apply one valid semantic negative mutation in memory, then invoke validate_static_manifest and validate_dto unchanged. No judged artifact is modified.

discriminatory_gate.classification_relation: Every case had the same actual classification in normal, repeat and reverse. Stability does not rescue the 20 surviving negatives.

blockers.finding: The checker proves only that an anchor needle occurs once in a hashed file/symbol. It does not validate the anchor_scope enum, the declared stable role/species/reach/cardinality, the baseline or forbidden-bindings contents, or fixture reachability. A dead display branch, a dead closure else branch and a cfg(test) function all pass as productive hooks.
blockers.reproduction: Run the harness command and inspect A01-A05; each returns Preserved.

blockers.finding: Carrier equality is checked at create/walk/replay-enter/replay-exit and witness only. It is not checked on outer/inner Func dispatch, With edge, closure dispatch or syntax-body enter/exit. Replay-exit Location is not tied back to walk, and snapshot-post needs only differ from snapshot-pre.
blockers.reproduction: Run the harness command and inspect A08-A15; each returns Preserved. C12 is a boundary control and returns Violated.

blockers.finding: A consistent final sequence proves neither append history nor productive hook hits. The checker accepts a fully regenerated predecessor/ordinal chain, accepts extra dict-produced events with unknown roles, and derives R from the DTO's own replay-enter claims. Data under an unknown Dict role is never type/span validated, allowing bool-as-int and swapped spans.
blockers.reproduction: Run the harness command and inspect A07, A16, A18-A20; each returns Preserved.

blockers.finding: Domain prefixes are checked, but fixed IDs reused across fresh runs and fabricated in-domain snapshot identities are accepted. The checker cannot distinguish runtime-derived IDs from constants or post-hoc claims.
blockers.reproduction: A06 deliberately disables remapping and still returns Preserved in normal/repeat/reverse.

blockers.finding: With the witness payload deliberately opaque, carrier loss at syntax-body enter is not checked; the checker returns Unknown instead of Violated. This contradicts the frozen Unknown policy.
blockers.reproduction: Run the harness command and inspect A21; actual is Unknown in all three modes.

stop_decision: A valid negative survived, so the mutation score is below 1.0 and the preseal gate must not issue SEALED_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION. Do not repair the judged checker in this adversary role; return the reproducible blockers to contract/oracle authority.
scope_exclusions: retention, discard, invalidation or terminal-policy closure
